# K2 Expedition 2026

Two service levels: base camp service (permits, porters, base camp meals) or full board (also high-altitude porters, oxygen and the summit push).

## Prices per person

| Group size | Base camp service | Full board |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1-2 members | $15,000 | $30,000 |
| 3-5 members | $11,000 | $29,000 |
| 6+ members | $8,500 | $28,000 |

The royalty and the liaison officer's fee are included in both.
